text:
nina: Heads-up — invoice-preview spike for a handful of tenants after the routing tag rollout. Seeing ~18% extra token counts in preview vs final for routes with `route_priority: P2`.
kevin: ugh. do we know if it's duplicate events or misattribution? :eyes:
nina: initial scan shows duplicate billing events with different `source_host` values. looks like the route-resolver started emitting a fallback tag and the ingest pipeline didn't dedupe across host variants.
raj: is this the routing-tag strip change from last week? that removed the normalized `route_id` from the proxy headers.
emily: yes — proxy change added a fallback header `x-route-legacy` for compatibility. ingest used `x-route` only. so some requests ended up with both and our dedupe key missed them.
ingest-bot: alert: invoice-preview-consistency-check failed for tenant t-42 (preview 18% > final). refs: grafana/dash/preview-vs-final
kevin: ok can we fix dedupe key in ingest quickly? patch to include both header variants before fingerprinting?
raj: quick fix: when building fingerprint use canonicalized tuple (route_id || x-route-legacy || ip_hash). should be safe and idempotent.
emily: agree. downside is we broaden dedupe surface — need to ensure no false merges across tenants. add tenant_id to fingerprint.
nina: good call. current fingerprint is `sha256(tenant_id + route_id + req_ts_bucket)`. we'll change to `sha256(tenant_id + coalesce(route_id,x-route-legacy) + req_ts_bucket + host_fingerprint)`.
kevin: can we do that as a hotfix in ingress service? minimal rollout: deploy to canary at 10% then promote.
raj: also need to backfill preview calculations? some invoices already generated but preview is the issue. previews are computed in real-time from the raw stream — fixing ingest will align preview going forward. no retroactive changes.
emily: logging: add a counter for "fingerprint-missing-route" and expose as dashboard card. Ops wants to know when fallback was used.
nina: also flagging console UX — Invoice Preview page should show a note when preview vs final diff > 5% and link to the route-tagging audit log.
kevin: agree — small UX banner is easy. add a help doc link.
raj: one more debate: should fingerprinting live in the edge proxy or server-side ingest? moving it edge reduces duplicates earlier but increases coupling and rollout complexity.
emily: i'm pro server-side: easier to iterate and we don't need to force proxy rollouts across clouds. but edge could reduce egress duplicates if misrouted.
nina: let's do server-side hotfix to resolve immediate issue. separately, start a short RFC for moving canonicalization to proxy with a migration plan.
kevin: timeline? canary in 2h, full in 6h if green?
raj: i can prepare the patch and tests, will push in ~45m. tests will include a small harness to emit both header variants and assert single fingerprint.
emily: i'll prep the dashboard card and console banner. nina, can you own the postmortem note in the invoices channel if it stays >5% for more than 24h?
nina: yep.
kevin: thanks everyone. add a runbook step: if preview spikes, run `curl -s https://infra-api/preview/compare?t=tenant` which returns preview vs final deltas.
raj: snippet for tests:
```
# simulate event variants
ev1 = {"tenant":"t-1","headers":{"x-route":"r1"},"tokens":120}
ev2 = {"tenant":"t-1","headers":{"x-route-legacy":"r1"},"tokens":120}
assert fingerprint(ev1) == fingerprint(ev2)
```
emily: :+1: will add graphs for the new counter.
ingest-bot: deploy-plan: ingress v2.13.1 canary -> 10% -> 100% if health ok. links: ci/12345
nina: keeping channel updated. will paste PR + canary link once ready.
